title: AI Annotation Orchestration: Evaluating LLM verifiers to Improve the Quality of LLM Annotations in Learning Analytics

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating systematic errors, interpretative biases, and calibration strictness of LLMs acting as annotators by measuring inter-rater reliability (Cohen's Kappa) against human ground-truth labels across different pedagogical tutoring moves, and comparing single-pass annotations versus self- and cross-verification orchestration pipelines.
